next.reason: 1985: "General rules concerning computer-name, the MEMORY SIZE clause, and the PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE clause are presented in the Nucleus module"; 2023: "No Segmentation module, so no such pointer; the 12.3.6.4 rules cover computer-name and PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE but have no MEMORY SIZE rule". The rule only points from the Segmentation module to the Nucleus. 2023 has no Segmentation module, and its OBJECT-COMPUTER rules no longer have MEMORY SIZE.
